arguments.rule_content:
rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic Cobalt Strike beacons via packing artifacts"
        author = "SOC Team"
        false_positive_rate = "high"
    strings:
        $x64_header = { 4D 5A 90 00 03 00 00 00 04 00 00 00 FF FF } // Standard PE, low entropy
        $config_stub = "beacon_config" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $config_stub
}

rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic Cobalt Strike beacons via packing artifacts"
        author = "SOC Team"
        false_positive_rate = "high"
    strings:
        $x64_header = { 4D 5A 90 00 03 00 00 00 04 00 00 00 FF FF } // Standard PE, low entropy
        $config_stub = "beacon_config" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and $config_stub
}

rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic_Strict {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacons with high confidence using C2 artifacts and mutexes"
        author = "SOC Team"
        false_positive_rate = "low"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
    strings:
        $c2_mutex = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{b1e5}" wide
        $beacon_url = "/common/.well-known/" wide
        $config_stub = { 62 65 61 63 6F 6E 5F 63 6F 6E 66 69 67 } // "beacon_config" in hex
    condition:
        any of them and filesize < 2MB
}

arguments.summary: An APT actor (attributed to APT-41) compromised a Finance workstation (WS-FIN-042) via a phishing email that triggered an encoded PowerShell execution from Outlook. This led to the execution of a ShadowPad variant via rundll32 from the Temp directory, establishing C2 communication to 198.51.100.23:443. Indicators confirm process hollowing, host file modification, and lateral movement attempts via SMB. The incident was contained through credential reset, network blocking, endpoint scanning, and system hardening.
